prompt:
`top_words` in `wordcount.py` miscounts: it treats "The" and "the" as different words, counts "cat." and "cat" separately, and returns words with equal counts in an arbitrary order.

Make it count words case-insensitively and return them lowercased; strip leading and trailing punctuation from each word (an apostrophe or hyphen inside a word stays, so "don't" and "well-known" are single words); drop tokens that are only punctuation; and break ties alphabetically. The existing tests must keep passing.

Make the change in this repository.
